import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    g = x*np.exp(-params[5]*x)
    c = np.cos(params[2]*t)
    s = np.sin(params[2]*t)
    c2 = np.cos(2*params[2]*t)
    s2 = np.sin(2*params[2]*t)
    return (params[0] + params[1]*c + params[3]*s + params[4]*g + params[6]*c2 + params[7]*s2
            + params[8]*v + params[9]*v*v)

import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
